title: Extraction and Contact
author: Dominic Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Brightwater, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
